speaker: Boss
subject: Shift?
text:
M. Want some overtime work?
Allison Corp HQ needs some extra coverage tonight. Need some security on the roof. Thomasin's pulled out sick, so you're it. Come on M, don't give me that look. Will be a quiet night. You'll be fine. Think of the holiday rates. 

Allison Corp, 11:30PM. Easy money. 

Thanks M,

speaker: Thomasin
subject: Sorry M
text: Hey M, sorry about tonight. I've caught a cold, and I don't want to make it worse out there. I'll make it up to you

speaker: Unknown
subject: New Glacier ICE
text: M. Got that ICE you requested. ssh://1zyys.adddscrr1pax.au/233zazz334f. Enjoy…

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *It was the night before christmas, and all through the city, not a creature was stirring, except for a Mouse…*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *A buzzing keeps going off in the distant haze of consciousness.*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *You look over. A new message notification flashes on your computer. Work. Sigh.*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *You yawn. A few more minutes wouldn't hurt, would it?*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *Kat, short  for Empress Katherine the Greatest Furbaby, first of her name.*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *Kat remained fast asleep, recharging. You'd finally saved up enough for a RealCat™ - with realistic claws and the softest tummy fur - AI pet a few months ago.*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *Which was no small feat on your class B salary.*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *No amount of caffeine is going to help you stay awake tonight*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *You can't just ignore the message from work*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *Your HPD worker class B employment contract even includes airconditioning with your apartment*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *A light drizzle falls over the sleeping city of Horizon*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: Hold it, who are you?

speaker: unknown
text: Does it matter? Nap time.

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *Static swells in fills your vision and the world suddenly fades to a silent grey…*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *Two notification alarms in one night… You come too on the rooftop. That alarm is actually coming from the police heli hovering overhead.*

speaker: Boss
text: Welcome back to reality M. First Thomasin calls off sick, then thieves enter the Allison facility and steal 21 TB of ghost data during a transfer.

speaker: Mouse PD
text: Boss, what are you doing here?

speaker: Boss
text: And you, M, let them walk right past.

speaker: Mouse PD
text: I had nothing to do with it…

speaker: Boss
text: I just watched the tapes, show you standing there the whole time while the thief walks right past you

speaker: Boss
text: It even looks like she stopped and had a chat. Do you deny that you're were colluding with the thief?

speaker: Mouse PD
text: That doesn't make sense.

speaker: Boss
text: I hope pay was worth it, because you are under arrest. Your employment at Hyperion PD has been terminated

speaker: Mouse PD
text: What, I…

speaker: Boss
text: All property of the HPD, including your HPD provided employee unit and all complementary property within revert immediately to the HPD's ownership

speaker: Boss
text: And as of 30 seconds ago, your social rights have reverted to class D

speaker: Boss
text: Now, if you'd be kind enough to stay still and hold out your hands, these fine security officers need to cuff you.

speaker: Mouse PD
text: *You know, M, you think to yourself. There is another option. You could always…*

speaker: Mouse PD
text: <color="#990000">Run!</color>

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: Take a seat, friend. You look down on your luck.

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: Another victim of the corp hegemony?

speaker: Mouse
text: *You nod.*

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: Who do you work for?

speaker: Mouse
text: Did. *You flash your useless HPD ID.*

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: Of course. Hungry?

speaker: Mouse
text: *You nod again*

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: Toppings?

speaker: Mouse
text: *You shrug.*

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: The works then. On the house.

speaker: Hotdog Vendor
text: A good evening starts with a good hotdog friend.

speaker: Anarchist
text: Class C Security, huh. I'd be careful flashing that card around here. I overheard your predicament.

speaker: Anarchist
text: What did you do? Penetration? Diving? Exploiting? Wait, don't tell me. You have the eyes of a solo.

speaker: Anarchist
text: I have work for somebody like you. If you're interested, of course... Simple slurp and dash. Walk in, fiddle some slots, walk out.

speaker: Anarchist
text: Easy work.

speaker: Mouse
text: *At this point, what do you have to lose? You know.*

speaker: Anarchist
text: *He slides a note and a memory stick to you across the counter. The note is the name of a corp.*

speaker: Anarchist
text: Speak to Salie when you're ready. She can get you in the front door. The rest will be on you.

speaker: Anarchist
text: Take everything you can get your hands on. The more, the happier I'll be. Meet me back here once you're done.

speaker: Mouse
text: Security?

speaker: Anarchist
text: *He shrugs.*Do what you need to do.
